description: A modified 5'-cap1 structure (m7G+m3'-5'-ppp-5'-Am). The two nucleotides printed for the cap are the 7-methylguanosine at position 1 and the first backbone nucleotide at position 2, joined by a 5'-to-5' triphosphate.
5'-untranslated region derived from human alpha-globin RNA with an optimized Kozak sequence. As used in BNT162b2.
Human serum albumin signal peptide, which directs the nascent polypeptide into the endoplasmic reticulum for secretion.
Codon-optimised single-chain variable fragment E113 against Echis carinatus phospholipase A2, preceded by the human serum albumin signal peptide, followed by a stop codon at 826 to 828.

A 3' untranslated region comprising two sequence elements derived from the amino-terminal enhancer of split (AES) mRNA and the mitochondrial encoded 12S ribosomal RNA, to confer RNA stability and high total protein expression. As used in BNT162b2.
A 110-nucleotide poly(A)-tail consisting of a stretch of 30 adenosine residues, followed by a 10-nucleotide linker sequence and another 70 adenosine residues.
